Overview

Chittagong is a city in Chittagong with a population of 8,500,000. Bangladesh’s principal seaport and second-largest city, a major industrial and commercial hub on the Bay of Bengal. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 27.0.
